bounded_scope: Contrastive pilot for modern standard written Turkish morphology, evidentiality and information-structure risks; no independent authority to approve Turkish publication.
nonessentialist_limit: A structural stress test, not a description of every Turkish speaker, region, genre or society.

ordinary_discourse: information-structure and evidential-processing studies: ev-hoffman-1997 and ev-arslan-2015
literary_calibration: not implemented as an author model; any Turkish literary asset requires work-specific expert review

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Narrow canonical SOV interacts with topic, focus and constrained order variation.
transformation_risks: linear order mistaken for a fixed information role

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Case, agreement, voice and derivation organize participants and agency.
transformation_risks: actor invented when agreement or context is underspecified
counterexamples_and_variation: word order alone does not determine agency

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Agglutinative suffix combinations encode tense, aspect and modality with lexical and contextual interaction.
transformation_risks: one suffix bundle split and one feature omitted
counterexamples_and_variation: morphological parse does not make event interpretation unique

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Indirect/inferential/reportative ranges are integrated with tense-aspect morphology; -miş is context-sensitive.
transformation_risks: indirect evidence flattened to direct assertion
counterexamples_and_variation: morphology does not establish truth or belief

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Agreement and context permit subject or pronoun omission.
counterexamples_and_variation: focus and ambiguity motivate overt forms

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Nonfinite verb forms, suffixal subordination and connectives build clause relations.
transformation_risks: nonfinite relation promoted to independent assertion

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Verbs, cases, derivation and compounds distribute path, cause and result.
counterexamples_and_variation: current pilot does not claim a general cognitive effect

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Topic initial and preverbal focus tendencies interact with SOV and prosody.
Address, person choice, modality and politeness strategies express social stance without a Japanese-isomorphic honorific system.
counterexamples_and_variation: regional, institutional and interpersonal norms vary

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Agglutinative words can package several grammatical distinctions that target languages distribute across words.
Morphological length, subordination, focus and prosody organize sentence breathing.
Formal written, everyday, regional and literary registers vary.
counterexamples_and_variation: current pilot excludes broad dialect and literary coverage
open_questions: no Turkish literary publication gate in this pilot

inbound_outbound_summary: Preserve every tense, aspect, modality, evidential, voice and person contribution when unpacking morphology.
Do not translate -miş as a single invariant hearsay marker or erase it into an unmarked assertion.
Formal Turkish publication requires native and morphology-specific review beyond this profile.
